system.description:
The character displays a dominant talent in certain selected situations and gains a minor or major edge (see BESM4, page 182) when making related dice rolls, depending on their Expertise Level.
Level 1: Character gains a minor edge with: one type of Skill roll; attack rolls with one narrow category of weapon; defence rolls with one narrow guarding category; a specific identified Attribute; opposed rolls when defending against an Attribute’s use
Level 2: As Level 1, but character gains a major edge instead
Level 3: Character gains a minor edge with: rolls related to one Stat; one type of attack roll or defence roll; a small group of related Attributes; one or more types of rolls under one environmental condition
Level 4: As Level 3, but character gains a major edge instead
Level 5: Character gains a minor edge with: all Skill rolls; all types of attack rolls; all types of defence rolls; Dynamic Powers or Power Flux
Level 6: As Level 5, but character gains a major edge instead
Level 7: Character gains a minor edge with: all Stat rolls; all combat rolls
Level 8: As Level 7, but character gains a major edge instead
Level 9: Character gains a minor edge with: all rolls
Level 10: As Level 9, but character gains a major edge instead
